steps.prompt: Before the check: which is easier for you now, flat grid problems or 3D solids? Why?

cards.title: The grid: quick review
cards.body: Distance $\sqrt{\Delta x^2 + \Delta y^2}$; slope $\frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}$; perpendicular slopes multiply to $-1$. Shoelace $\frac{1}{2}|\sum (x_i y_{i+1} - x_{i+1} y_i)|$; Pick $I + \frac{B}{2} - 1$. $90^\circ$ counterclockwise: $(-y, x)$; over $y = x$: $(y, x)$.

cards.title: Solids: quick review
cards.body: Cylinder $\pi r^2 h$; cone $\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h$, curved area $\pi r \ell$; sphere $\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3$, $4\pi r^2$. Space diagonal $\sqrt{a^2 + b^2 + c^2}$; unfold for surface paths; $V - E + F = 2$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ AMC-style problems with choices, easiest first, no hints. You need all $8$ right (100%) to pass. If you miss one, you'll see the solutions and which skills to review, and the next try gives you new problems.

prompts: Which habit from this unit will you use first on your next test?
Which skill will you keep practising in the daily review?
